turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Here is the rule. We use am, is or are + a verb with -ing to say what is happening now. For example: Two children are playing football.

Here is your exercise. Imagine a park. Write two sentences about what people are doing now.
